First time? Just follow these steps

Even on your first Seoul trip, ① → ⑤ is all you need.

  1. 1
    Flights + entry prep (K-ETA)
    Arriving via Incheon Airport (ICN). Compare flights ↗
    Check K-ETA / visa before you go: visa-free entry countries (US, Canada, EU, etc.) may need to apply for K-ETA in advance, and rules vary by nationality and change often. Before departure, check the rules for your own nationality on the official site k-eta.go.kr.
  2. 2
    Airport → stay
    Limousine bus 6705A (Incheon Airport T1/T2 ↔ Jamsil / Lotte World, no transfer — 18,000 KRW — best for first-timers) · Airport Railroad + Line 9 · taxi (~70,000–90,000 KRW).
    How to buy a ticket & the WOWPASS pickup order: see the ‘Your first hour’ timeline →
  3. 3
    Book a stay
    Four stays in the Jamsil area near the venue — pick after seeing the routes.
    See stays →
  4. 4
    Concert day
    Bring your physical passport (required) · arrive early for ID check · MD booths in the morning · show starts Fri 19:00 / Sat 18:00 / Sun 17:00 KST.
  5. 5
    Getting home
    All three nights have last-train room. Only Line 9 westbound (Gaehwa) on Sat/Sun is early (~22:55). See last trains & back-calc table →
🛬 Your first hour after landing — just do this
  1. Activate your eSIM — turn on the eSIM you installed before the flight, right after landing. (No SIM-counter queue needed.)
  2. Get a WOWPASS — issue the card at a self-service kiosk on the arrivals floor (~5 min). Just bring your passport.
  3. Board bus 6705A — Incheon Airport T1/T2 ↔ Jamsil limousine (18,000 KRW, no transfer — stops at a few stations en route before Jamsil). Pay at the airport 1F booth / self-service machine, or tap a WOWPASS / transit card on board. Last bus from the airport ~22:55 (T1 23:15) — for a late flight, take the AREX (Airport Railroad) + Line 9 or a taxi instead.
💳 WOWPASS, don't worry — 3 steps and you're done

Foreign-card 3DS checks fail often, so grabbing a prepaid WOWPASS in advance saves the stress. The flow is simple:

  1. Issue — reserve online on the official site and pick it up at an airport kiosk without queuing, or just issue it at a WOWPASS kiosk on the Incheon arrivals floor (or a subway station). About 5 minutes; bring your passport + the 6,000 KRW issuance fee (official registration fee, non-refundable).
  2. Top up — install the WOWPASS app and load it with a foreign card (VISA · MC · AMEX). (App top-up 4% fee · kiosk top-up free.)
  3. Done — one card now covers ticket payments, transit, and convenience stores.

WOWPASS official site · app download ↗

You can also reserve online (Reserve Card) on the official site — handy for skipping the airport kiosk line. Enter your passport's English name exactly (a single wrong letter can mean entry denial).

🧭 Local travel essentials
Getting around
Subway (Lines 1–9, Sinbundang Line, etc.) and city buses dominate the Capital Region. Integrated multi-modal transit system. Standard transit cards: T-money and Cashbee—accepted at nearly all transit and convenience stores.
Language
Korean is the main language. Major tourist sites, concert venues, and transit have English signage. Day-to-day English varies—moderate overall.
Last train
All three nights have room. The only catch: Line 9 westbound (Gaehwa) on Sat/Sun ends ~22:55 → board by 22:30. Full last-train & back-calc table → After last trains: Owl Bus, taxis, Kakao T (see ‘Late-night transit apps’ below).
See more
Payment
Cards and mobile payments (Samsung Pay, etc.) widely accepted. Street vendors and small transactions may need cash. QR codes (Kakao Pay, Naver Pay) are common.
Currency & exchange
Currency: Korean won (KRW, ₩). Card payments are standard, so exchange needs are minimal. ATMs and exchange bureaus available at airports and city centers.
Local apps
Kakao T (Taxis, driver services, and ride-hailing available) · Naver Map (Public transit routes & real-time directions) · Kakao Pay (QR codes, quick-pay)
Late-night transit
Kakao T (Night-taxi standard (90%+ market share, fastest matching). Foreign phone sign-up restricted.) · Uber (Taxi hailing—bring your overseas card & number. Made for travelers.) · TADA (Carnival vans—sign up with your overseas number & card.) · i.M (Book premium minivan taxis.) · K-RIDE (Traveler-only taxis (no KakaoTalk; Seoul, Incheon & metro).) · Owl Bus (Seoul Night Bus) (After last train: night buses—official Seoul routes (N15, N16, N26 & more).)  📶 eSIM ↗
How to book
Don't hail from the venue—walk 1–2 blocks out, you'll match faster. Go a station farther, demand drops.
Around the venue
Olympic Park Peace Gate 📍Monument to the '88 Olympics in sprawling park grounds. Popular for strolls and photos.
Lotte World Mall 📍Large complex mall with Olive Young, duty-free, K-fashion, observation deck. One-stop shopping before and after the concert.

🎫 Ticketing
Show Times
Three nights — Fri 7/10 19:00 (= 5:00 AM CDT) · Sat 7/11 18:00 (= 4:00 AM CDT) · Sun 7/12 17:00 KST (= 3:00 AM CDT, US Central). Main show approx. 2h 40m (+α with encore)
Pre-Sale
Fan club ONCE presale 2026-06-09 20:00–23:59 KST
General Sale
2026-06-11 20:00 KST (= 6:00 AM CDT, US Central)
Where to Book
NOL Ticket (world.nol.com) ↗
Price Range
Standing General 154,000 KRW (≈$110), Reserved General 154,000 KRW (≈$110)
Standing = floor, no assigned seat (entry by queue order) · Reserved = numbered seat. Seoul's seat layout isn't publicly confirmed — general definition.
Foreigner payment
Overseas cards (Visa, Master, etc.) work, but 3DS authentication often fails → a prepaid card (WOWPASS) is recommended. 3DS (3-D Secure): an extra identity check your card issuer runs before payment (SMS OTP / app auth).One WOWPASS = transit card (subway · bus · taxi) + prepaid payment card in one — issue a single card at the airport on arrival and it covers both getting around and paying (see the 'first hour after landing' timeline above). WOWPASS (a NOL World partner) can be reserved online (Reserve Card) on the official site → skip the airport kiosk line, or issue it in person at 160+ unmanned kiosks (airport, subway, etc.; 6,000 KRW registration fee); top up in the WOWPASS app with an overseas card (VISA/MC/AMEX, etc. — 4% fee for app top-ups, free at kiosks). Enter your passport name in English exactly (one wrong letter risks entry denial). Bring your physical passport on the day. Confirm the exact pickup method on the ticketing site notice.If you only need a transit card, the T-money Korea Tour Card (4,000 KRW cash at convenience stores) is an alternative — but it has no payment-card function.
Safe resale
Use the official transfer system / escrow. Before paying, check the account & phone number on TheCheat (Korean-only site — pair it with a translation app such as Papago or Google Lens) · if you're a victim, report via the Korean Police ECRM (mostly Korean, English support unconfirmed; requires identity verification (mobile / I-PIN) — the victim files in person). Never share photos of your passport or ID. Avoid premium DM deals on social media (foreigners are a known scam target).
🎤 Setlist — the song lineup changes each night; check setlist.fm after the show

The THIS IS FOR World Tour runs roughly 35–40 songs · 4 acts + member solo stages · about 2h20m–2h40m.

Song order and structure change show to show, and the Seoul (final) date may differ further — finals tend to run longer talk segments and encores.

For the confirmed setlist, check setlist.fm → TWICE setlists (setlist.fm) ↗

🎟 How to catch cancelled tickets (general patterns)

Returns drop irregularly. Typical hot windows:

  • Interpark 09:00–09:10 · Yes24 00:03–00:05 · Melon 00:12–00:20
  • Unpaid 2nd-wave release = 0–2 AM the night after booking
  • D-1 & same-day last-minute cancellations cluster

Cancellation deadline: 17:00 the day before the show (NOL / Interpark) — no cancel/refund after.
